name: Apart
source:
Main character lives in an apartment room, but he is actually a ghost. Eventually he learns how to manipulate items. At first he is terrible at it, so inhabitants suffer a lot from his presence. Today is a new stage of the experiment - to play with woman body.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角住在公寓房间里，但他实际上是一个鬼魂。最终他学会了如何操纵物品。起初他的表现很糟糕，所以居民们因为他的出现而遭受了很多痛苦。今天是实验的新阶段——玩弄女人的身体。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
